newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 6.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Government nominates Jean-Rene Bernard and Pierre Guillen to Bank of France monetary policy council. The two are political allies of President Jacques Chirac.
-- French, British and German futures and options markets seek to attract euro-denominated transactions as European markets prepare for European single currency.
-- Generale des Eaux says it sold real estate assets worth some seven billion francs in the last days of 1996, bringing total asset sales for the year to 13.3 billion.
